title: v5.108.40 shipped: Batched release: room rules screens, sub-HIGH photo alerts reach the digest, music test leak
summary: Batched release: room rules screens, sub-HIGH photo alerts reach the digest, music test leak
why: Room-rules picks took the operator defaults (keep / B / B, unvetoed since 11-20) because v5.108.39 shipped the rules without them and the screens were the last piece of that arc. The alert fix widens the existing v5.108.17 digest fallback instead of lowering channel severity gates, since lowering gates would change delivery for every MEDIUM alert, a policy the operator never picked; the photo is lost in the digest, which beats reaching nobody. The music test fix restores what it swaps so later test files see real classes. Each branch passed its own reviews, mutation drills and a full-suite name-diff, and the merged develop passed a full name-diff (23864 passed, 0 new).
implications: Shipped AI-ROOM-RULES-TRUST-REPAIR-1, NM-SECURITY-IMAGE-SUBHIGH-NO-ROUTE-1, TEST-MUSIC-SYSMODULES-LEAK-1 at v5.108.40; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.108.40.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: notification_log rows for perimeter_alert with bucket_outcome='no_channel_fired' stay at 0 after the restart, LOW/MEDIUM perimeter alerts appear as digest rows, and one Run-an-automation room rule runs end to end with a decision row
